parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true`: `Playcut.stub` in `_Plant_PlaycutStub.swift` and `Breakpoint.stub` in `PlaylistStubs.swift` are test-fixture factory methods living under `PlaylistTesting`. Per the decision rules, any cluster where even one record is test-marked must be treated as a test-fixture and left alone; here both records are test-only, making the restraint unambiguous. Merging or genericizing stub factories couples test-fixture semantics into shared production-facing code, which is the canonical anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent.
